svg:
Market Simulator architecture The promotion decision Kafka topic enters a Simulation and Learning Runtime. A DecisionListener validates the event and calls a pure deterministic SimulationEngine using hidden simulator v1 configuration and scenario-seeded noise. The engine returns PromotionOutcomeV1 to the Evaluator, which replays all four discounts through the same engine.
Market Simulator one hidden deterministic engine for chosen-action simulation and all counterfactual replay
Kafka promotion.decisions.v1 group: market-simulator-v1
SIMULATION + LEARNING RUNTIME Â· ONE KOTLIN / SPRING BOOT PROCESS
DecisionListener schema + invariant validation manual Kafka ackowledgement
SimulationEngine pure deterministic function stock cap + gross profit
PromotionOutcomeV1 stable outcome_id units_sold + gross_profit
Evaluator / Learner oracle replay + regret PromotionCase + Lesson
SimulatorV1Config hidden coefficients SIMULATOR_VERSION=v1
Deterministic noise SHA-256(v1|scenario_id) same shock for all actions
